scope: PR-only state observation glue and passive native hook proposals. No hook registration, trust change, client configuration, host backfill, installation, model call or native client acceptance.

upstream_sources.observation: Official command-hook example appends timestamp/source/file metadata. State deduplication and cross-client identity reconciliation are local integration glue.
Native ConfigChange, FileChanged, SessionStart watchPaths, async command and audit-only InstructionsLoaded interfaces. No instruction or decision payload is retained.
Native background command hooks and exact-definition trust. New groups must be appended without shifting existing indices; trust remains needs_user.
Pinned native input/output schemas read unchanged from official source. The recorder emits no decision or additionalContext.
POSIX exclusive nonblocking flock for deduplication; lock contention is an observer error, never a client decision.

controls_and_limits: Local fixtures independently inspect actual rows, hashes, add/remove/add identities, canonical aliases, bytecode exclusions, safe instruction hashing, metadata-status arguments and pending-journal recovery.
Busy-lock and malformed-input negative controls produce observer errors while ordinary hook invocations return zero and emit no decision/context.
Supporting-file fingerprints use stat metadata, not file content or reconstructed Git trees; restored metadata can evade that observation.
Public lock source metadata is a declaration. Plugin/bundled identities do not borrow a same-name global lock source.
S4 metadata-only subprocess boundary is checked with a local mock; native integration awaits the S4 change. No live native-client subprocess was started.
Fresh Claude/Codex hook firing, Codex trust positive/skipped controls, real upstream add/remove, ledger backfill and representative latency acceptance remain untested.
Proposed unchanged-path p95 bound is 250 ms; changed observer/status work is asynchronous with bounded timeouts. Fixture suite duration is not a production latency measurement.
Missing installation provenance, source refs, plugin activation, native model reads, provider identity and usage stay unknown.
sanitization: No raw logs, hook payloads, instruction bodies, personal host paths, credentials or active client configuration are copied into this receipt.
